question.text: A spherical ball of mass 20 kg is stationary at the top of a hill of height 100 m . It rolls down a smooth surface to the ground, then climbs up another hill of height 30 m and finally rolls down to a horizontal base at a height of 20 m above the ground. The velocity attained by the ball is

solution.text: Using conservation of energy, $\mathrm{m}(10 \times 100)=\mathrm{m}\left(\frac{1}{2} \mathrm{v}^2+10 \times 20\right)$ or $\frac{1}{2} v^2=800$ or $v=\sqrt{1600}=40 \mathrm{~m} / \mathrm{s}$
